title: Donor engineering to regulate fluorescence of a symmetrical structure based on a fluorene bridge for white light emission
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,34311-34319
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA05803H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xiaoling Xie, Jingjing Liu, Haocheng Zhao, Lei Yan, Yuling Wu, Yanqin Miao, Hua Wang
White light emission is modulated with CIE coordinates located at (0.33, 0.38) via proportional regulation with a mixture of blue light FFA and complementary yellow light FCzA with the same fluorene bridge in a ratio of 10 : 3.
